issue_request: FHIR-50219 is an Applied/Persuasive with Modification Security WG R6 change request asking for a Permission search parameter on Permission.rule.activity.actor.reference so Permission resources can be found by the actor to whom an activity rule applies. The approved resolution was to add a SearchParameter for Permission.rule.activity.actor.reference.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR 3522 applied the request. Local history shows e35c6b3ba4e1b2de2e6d30e17f3fe78feb4e706a adding Permission-rule-activity-actor to source/permission/bundle-Permission-search-params.xml and 0c4d08d0b8f884a863c3a48bc993439535f1ca32 normalizing the code to rule-activity-actor.
additional_context: Permission is no longer in the current core build. Commit 0e2a8a7f839d5e1a43787523daccf07d958362f3 removed source/permission and active source/fhir.ini Permission entries, while current core narrative links Permission to the HL7 Data Access Policies IG. The current HL7/data-access-policies source includes Permission-rule-activity-actor with code rule-activity-actor, type reference, and expression Permission.rule.activity.actor.reference. Companion issues FHIR-50220, FHIR-50221, and FHIR-50222 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The seed request was applied before reconciliation, and the authoritative current Permission source now belongs outside this FHIR core checkout.
